What happens to my Pinterest when I die?

By the Afterkeep research team · Reviewed on 2 Nov 2026

Short answer: Pinterest will delete a deceased family member's account if you contact Pinterest and provide verification, such as an obituary or death certificate. It doesn't memorialise accounts, and it won't give out login or personal information. Once deleted, the account can't be accessed. Only the account holder can download the account's data, so save any boards you want kept while you can still log in.

Key facts

  • Deletion on request with an obituary or death certificate
  • No memorialisation option
  • No login or personal information released
  • Self-deletion: data permanently deleted after 7 days

How do I prepare my Pinterest account?

  1. Note your Pinterest login email in your digital estate plan, and keep the password in a password manager with emergency access.
  2. Want your boards kept? Download your data: Settings, Privacy and data, Request your data, Start request. Pinterest emails a link within 48 hours.
  3. After a death: contact Pinterest through its help centre contact form (help.pinterest.com/contact) and ask for the deceased family member's account to be deleted.
  4. Include verification such as an obituary or death certificate.
  5. With the login, the account can instead be deleted from Settings, Account management, Delete account. The profile is deactivated at once and data deleted after 7 days.
  6. Check it's gone by visiting pinterest.com/username without logging in. Logging in to a deactivated account reactivates it.

Read the official policy ↗

What documents do heirs need?

  • The person's Pinterest profile or username
  • Verification such as an obituary or death certificate

How long does it take?

Pinterest publishes no processing time for deceased-account requests. When an account is deleted from settings, the public profile is deactivated immediately and the account and data are permanently deleted after 7 days.

What can't be recovered?

  • Boards, Pins and the profile, once the account is deleted
  • Account data, which Pinterest only releases to the verified account holder

Frequently asked questions

What happens to my Pinterest when I die?

Pinterest will delete a deceased family member's account if you contact Pinterest and provide verification, such as an obituary or death certificate. It doesn't memorialise accounts, and it won't give out login or personal information. Once deleted, the account can't be accessed. Only the account holder can download the account's data, so save any boards you want kept while you can still log in.

What happens to my Pinterest account when I die?

It stays as it is until someone acts. Pinterest will delete a deceased family member's account after you contact it with verification such as an obituary or death certificate.

Can family get into a dead person's Pinterest?

No. Pinterest says it can't give out any personal or login information, to protect users' privacy.

Does Pinterest memorialise accounts?

No. Pinterest's help centre only describes deleting a deceased person's account.

Can family download a deceased person's Pinterest data?

Pinterest says only the account holder can access their data, after verification. Download your own data now if you want boards kept.

How long until a deleted Pinterest account is gone?

The profile is deactivated immediately and the data is permanently deleted after 7 days. It can be reactivated within those 7 days by logging in.
